product_metadata.title: KINDEN Wood Stove Fan 5-Blade - Heat Powered Log Burner Eco-Friendly with Stove Thermometer (Aluminium Black, Large Size) Patent Pending
features: ✅[Updated 5-Blade]: Air Flow: 370CFM(Max.), Running Speed: 1360 RPM(Max), 5-Blade fan starts to rotate when temperature reach 60°C(140°F), The hotter the fire, the faster the blades turn.
